### Risk review entry — 30 September 2026 **Finding: Limit breached by 0.26 percentage points.** The September 2026 fund factsheets report the direct long holding of the iShares USD Treasury Bond 7–10yr UCITS ETF (abbreviated as “ISHS $ TSY BOND 7-10YR UCITS ETF”) as follows: | Fund | Account weight | ETF holding | Account contribution | | ------------------ | -------------- | ----------- | -------------------- | | MyMap 3 Select ESG | 40.00% | 9.95% | 3.98% | | MyMap 5 Select ESG | 60.00% | 8.80% | 5.28% | | **Total** | **100.00%** |
| **9.26%** | **Calculation:** (40% × 9.95%) + (60% × 8.80%) = 3.98% + 5.28% = **9.26%**. Against the account limit of 9.00%, the disclosed exposure exceeds the limit by **0.26 percentage points**. The reviewer can therefore conclude that the model account was **non-compliant as at 30 September 2026**, based on the supplied holdings and account weights. **Documents and dates used:** - *MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund*, September 2026 factsheet, Class S Acc British Pound: PDF page 1 establishes the portfolio reporting date of 30 September 2026; PDF page 3, “Top 10 Holdings”, reports 9.95%. - *MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund*, September 2026 factsheet, Class X Acc British Pound: PDF page 1 establishes the same reporting date; PDF page 3, “Top 10 Holdings”, reports 8.80%. - *BlackRock Investment Funds Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements*, year ended 28 February 2025: MyMap 3 Portfolio Statement, PDF page 252 (printed page 251), and MyMap 5 Portfolio Statement, PDF page 317 (printed page 316), identify the ETF by its full name. Their historical holdings of 13.42% and 2.28%, respectively, are **not used** in the September 2026 calculation. **Scope:** The assessment includes only the directly reported long position in the named ETF in each fund. It excludes other Treasury funds, indirect exposures and derivatives. Calculations use the percentages at their printed precision. The conclusion relates to the reported 30 September 2026 position, not subsequent holdings. Supporting record references: MyMap 3 September factsheet MyMap_3_Select_ESG.txt ; MyMap 5 September factsheet MyMap_5_Select_ESG.txt ; 2025 annual report, MyMap 3 BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.txt and MyMap 5 BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.txt .
